summary: Updated orchestrator.js to use namespaced #/projects/{repo}/{slug}/... URL form throughout the queue view.
In _buildQueueHtml(): log link now uses #/projects/{repo}/{slug}/runs/{filename} when expectedRepo is non-null; legacy entries without expectedRepo do not render a log link.
In _bindQueueActions(): View Project link now uses #/projects/{repo}/{slug} when expectedRepo is non-null; legacy entries without expectedRepo omit the link (explicit comment added for clarity).
In _mountLogPreviews(): now gates on expectedRepo presence and passes expectedRepo as first argument to OrchestratorWidgets.renderLogPreview() for future-readiness when the widgets file is updated.

Updated orchestrator-view.test.ts: added expectedRepo field to makeEntry() default fixture, updated existing project-link test to assert namespaced URL, updated log-preview tests to include expectedRepo, added 5 new tests covering all WP-011 acceptance criteria.
All 1129 tests across 38 test files pass.

comments.note: orchestrator-widgets.js `renderLogPreview(container, slug, filename)` still calls `API.getRunLogEntries(slug, filename, afterLine)` with the old 3-argument signature. After WP-001 migrated `api-client.js` to `getRunLogEntries(repo, slug, filename, afterLine)`, the widget's internal API call is misaligned — `repo` is being passed as `slug`, `slug` as `filename`, and `afterLine` as the start offset. This will produce broken log preview fetches at runtime. The _mountLogPreviews() update in this WP passes `expectedRepo` to `renderLogPreview` but the widget itself needs a matching signature update.

The legacy fallback branch in _bindQueueActions() (entry with null expectedRepo but projectExists=true) is an explicit empty else-if with only a comment. Consider omitting the else-if entirely, or surfacing a subtle visual indicator ('legacy entry') so operators know why no link appears.

The WP-011 spec file is stored as work/WP-006.md but the ledger entry references it as WP-011 — this mismatch between file name and ledger ID may cause confusion for future agents reading the plan directory.

summary: All 4 WP-011 acceptance criteria verified — 34 dedicated tests pass (100%). Full regression run: 2834 tests across 92 files, all green, zero regressions.

comments.note: AC-1 verified: _buildQueueHtml() guards `entry.logFilename && entry.expectedRepo && entry.expectedSlug` before constructing the log link. Test 'renders log link with namespaced #/projects/{repo}/{slug}/runs/{filename} form' PASS.

AC-2 verified: _bindQueueActions() guards `entry.expectedRepo && entry.expectedSlug` before constructing the View Project link. Test 'renders View Project link with namespaced #/projects/{repo}/{slug} form' PASS.

AC-3 verified: Legacy entries (null expectedRepo) hit the explicit empty else-if branch in _bindQueueActions() and hit the else-if(!entry.progress) fallback in _buildQueueHtml() — no broken URLs generated. Both tests PASS.
AC-4 verified: AC-4 test walks all <a href> links in the rendered table and asserts every #/projects/ URL has at least 2 path segments (repo + slug). PASS.

Pre-existing debt confirmed (not introduced by WP-011): orchestrator-widgets.js renderLogPreview() still calls API.getRunLogEntries(slug, filename, afterLine) with the old 3-arg form, while api-client.js now requires (repo, slug, filename, afterLine). This will cause broken log preview fetches at runtime — repo is passed as slug, slug as filename. WP-011 correctly passes expectedRepo to renderLogPreview() at the call site but the widget's internal API call needs a matching update. This should be addressed in a follow-up WP.

Edge case verified: entry with logFilename + expectedSlug but expectedRepo=null AND progress=null falls through to 'Waiting for log…' fallback span — correct graceful behavior, no broken URL constructed.

Edge case verified: _mountLogPreviews() guard (!entry.logFilename || !entry.expectedRepo || !entry.expectedSlug) prevents renderLogPreview() from being called for entries missing any of the three required fields.

Pre-existing (not introduced by WP-011): orchestrator-widgets.js renderLogPreview() calls API.getRunLogEntries(slug, filename, afterLine) with the old 3-arg signature; api-client.js now requires 4 args (repo, slug, filename, afterLine).
